blocks.text: 16. The Last City of Many Forms

Real-world analogue: Cliff settlements such as Matera, mud-brick vertical cities such as Shibam, canal districts, hillside transit cities, caravan hubs, and old port cities whose routes were built for different vehicles, bodies, eras, and social systems.
World relation: Open World pluralism, Pilgrim World embodiment and travel, and Continuity World care for displaced histories. No single district defines the city.
Connection to newer locations: The city connects to Doorway Plaza, Monsoon Stepwell City, Urban Canyon Hive, City of Rainward Roofs, Inland Sea of Doors, and Mosaic Worldscar.
Abstract or metaphorical relation: Coexistence does not mean forcing every body onto the same street. A city becomes inclusive by maintaining multiple valid ways through it.
